# Tool reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen_tools_doc.py from the live tool schemas - do not edit. -->

31 tools. Lengths are in the configured unit (**millimeters by default**, inches with `ONSHAPE_UNITS=imperial`); angles are degrees. See [configuration](configuration.md).

Legend: 🔍 read-only · ✏️ modifies a document · ⚠️ destructive.

## Server & diagnostics

Know what the server is configured to do.

### `get_settings` 🔍

Show this server's active settings: the unit system every length uses (metric = mm by default, or imperial = inches), whether screenshots are sent to you for visual review, read-only mode, and the Onshape API target. Never reveals API keys. Call this first so you know which unit to use for lengths.

_No parameters._

### `whoami` 🔍

Verify that the configured credentials (API keys or OAuth sign-in) work by asking Onshape which account they belong to. Use it to diagnose authentication problems before doing real work.

_No parameters._

## Documents

Find, create and organise documents and their tabs.

### `list_documents` 🔍

List or search Onshape documents. Returns each document's ID (needed by every other tool), name and last-modified time. Use `offset` with `next_offset` to page.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | no | Case-insensitive text to look for in document names. |
| `scope` | 'mine' \| 'created' \| 'shared' \| 'recent' \| 'public' | no | Which documents to list. Default: `mine`. |
| `sort_by` | 'modified' \| 'created' \| 'name' | no | Default: `modified`. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Page size. Default: `20`. |
| `offset` | integer | no | Skip this many results (paging). Default: `0`. |

### `get_document` 🔍

Describe one document: its main workspace ID and every element (tab) in it - Part Studios, Assemblies, Drawings, imported files - with their element IDs and types. A tab flagged has_default_name still carries Onshape's placeholder name: rename it with `rename` to say what it holds.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |

### `create_document` ✏️

Create a new Onshape document in the user's account (private by default). Follow with `create_element` to add a Part Studio (new documents may start empty).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Document name. |
| `description` | string | no | Optional description. |
| `public` | boolean | no | Make the document visible to everyone. Leave false unless the user's plan requires it: Onshape's FREE plan can only create public documents (the call then fails and tells you to retry with public=true - only do that after the user agrees). Default: `False`. |

### `create_element` ✏️

Add a new Part Studio (where parts are modeled) or Assembly tab to a document and return its element ID.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `name` | string | yes | Tab name. |
| `kind` | 'part_studio' \| 'assembly' | no | Type of element to add. Default: `part_studio`. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |

## Inspect

Read-only views of a model: features, parts, measurements, faces/edges, assemblies.

### `list_features` 🔍

List the feature tree of a Part Studio in order: feature ID, name, type (newSketch, extrude, fillet, ...) and health status (OK / WARNING / ERROR). Check this after creating features - an ERROR status means the feature failed to build.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |
| `feature_id` | string | no | If set, return the full raw JSON of just this feature (useful as a template for add_feature or to see its parameter IDs for update_feature). |

### `list_parts` 🔍

List the parts (solid/surface bodies) in a Part Studio with their part IDs, which other tools accept to focus on one part. A part flagged has_default_name is still called "Part N": give it a descriptive name with `rename`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |

### `get_part_properties` 🔍

Measure geometry: the axis-aligned bounding box (min/max/size) plus volume, surface area, mass and centroid per part, in the configured length unit. Use it to verify dimensions and orientation after modeling. Mass is only meaningful if the part has a material assigned in Onshape.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |
| `part_id` | string | no | Measure only this part (from list_parts). |
| `configuration` | object | no |  |
| `tight` | boolean | no | Use Onshape's TIGHT bounding box (default). The quick REST box can be too large on swept surfaces such as threads (0.5 mm per side on an M10 nut); false returns that quick box. Default: `True`. |

### `get_body_details` 🔍

List the faces (and optionally edges) of each part with their IDs, geometry type, area, a point on the face and its outward normal, all in the configured length unit. Use face IDs as `plane` in create_sketch to sketch on a face, and edge IDs for fillet / chamfer. Output is capped for very large parts.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |
| `part_id` | string | no | Only this part (from list_parts). |
| `include_edges` | boolean | no | Also list edges (needed for fillet / chamfer). Default: `True`. |
| `configuration` | object | no |  |

### `get_assembly` 🔍

Describe an Assembly: its instances (parts/sub-assemblies), where each is placed (translation in the configured length unit) and its mates.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |

### `list_custom_features` 🔍

List custom features (Feature Studio scripts such as Thread Creator) that add_custom_feature can add: feature_type, namespace and every parameter with its type, unit, default and options. Also lists the custom features this Part Studio already uses. Built-in Onshape features are not listed - use the dedicated tools for those.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |
| `feature_studio_url` | string | no | Optional browser URL of a Feature Studio tab (.../documents/<did>/w\|v\|m/<id>/e/<eid>). Lists the custom features that studio defines instead of the ones this Part Studio already knows about. Use it for a Feature Script added to your account that is not yet in this Part Studio. To add features from another document, use its version URL (/v/). |

### `list_variables` 🔍

List the variables of a Part Studio: name, type, the expression it was set with and its current value (lengths in the configured unit, angles in degrees). A variable that depends on a configuration input also shows configured_by and its value per option. Reference a variable as '#name' in sketch sizes, extrude depths, fillet radii, thread pitch, etc.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |

### `get_configuration` 🔍

List the configuration inputs of a Part Studio (for example a 'Size' list with M10 and M18, or a 'Length'), with their options and defaults. Names are the labels shown in Onshape; for an input made in Onshape's UI the generated `id` (and `option_ids`) are shown beside them. Other tools take a `configuration` such as {"Size": "M18"} (labels or IDs) to measure or look at one variant.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |

### `run_featurescript` 🔍

Evaluate a read-only FeatureScript snippet against a Part Studio and return its result. Powerful for queries the other tools do not cover (face counts, distances, evaluating selections). It cannot modify the document. NOTE: lengths inside FeatureScript results are in METERS, not the configured unit.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `script` | string | yes | A FeatureScript lambda, e.g. `function(context is Context, queries) { return size(evaluateQuery(context, qEverything(EntityType.FACE))); }`. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |

## Model

Create and edit Part Studio geometry. Hidden entirely when `ONSHAPE_READ_ONLY=true`.

### `create_sketch` ✏️

Create a sketch of 2D shapes on a plane or planar face. Point coordinates are [x, y] in the sketch's own axes, in the configured length unit (mm by default). Returns the sketch's feature_id, to pass to `extrude`. Tip: verify placement afterwards with get_part_properties or a screenshot.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `shapes` | array of Rectangle \| Circle \| Line \| Arc \| Polygon \| Hexagon | yes | 2D shapes to draw: rectangle, circle, hexagon, line, arc or polygon. Closed shapes become regions that `extrude` can turn into solids. Sizes (diameter, radius, width, height, across_flats) may be variables such as '#shank_diameter': the sketch then follows the variable. |
| `plane` | string | no | 'Top' (XY plane), 'Front' (XZ plane) or 'Right' (YZ plane) of the origin, or the ID of a planar face / plane from get_body_details to sketch on an existing face. Default: `Top`. |
| `name` | string | no | Default: `Sketch`. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |

**Shape types** (`type` selects one). Coordinates are `[x, y]` in the sketch plane,
in the configured length unit, or strings with a unit such as `"1.5 in"`:

- **`arc`** - Circular arc, counter-clockwise from `start_angle` to `end_angle` (degrees from +X).

  | Field | Type | Required | Description |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `construction` | boolean | no | Construction geometry is a reference only: it never forms extrudable regions. Default: `False`. |
  | `center` | array of number \| string | yes | [x, y] in the sketch plane, in the configured length unit (or strings with units, e.g. ['10 mm', '0.5 in']). |
  | `radius` | number \| string | yes | Number in the configured length unit, a string like '12.5 mm' / '0.5 in', or a Part Studio variable such as '#diameter' (the sketch then follows the variable). |
  | `start_angle` | number | yes | Degrees, measured counter-clockwise from the sketch +X. |
  | `end_angle` | number | yes | Degrees; the arc runs counter-clockwise up to this angle. |

- **`circle`** - Full circle. Give either `radius` or `diameter`.

  | Field | Type | Required | Description |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `construction` | boolean | no | Construction geometry is a reference only: it never forms extrudable regions. Default: `False`. |
  | `center` | array of number \| string | yes | [x, y] in the sketch plane, in the configured length unit (or strings with units, e.g. ['10 mm', '0.5 in']). |
  | `radius` | number \| string | no | Radius (or give `diameter`). |
  | `diameter` | number \| string | no | Diameter (or give `radius`). |

- **`hexagon`** - Regular hexagon with flat sides at the top and bottom (corners on the sketch X axis). Size it by `across_flats` (the wrench size, e.g. 16 for an M10 bolt head or '#head_af').

  | Field | Type | Required | Description |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `construction` | boolean | no | Construction geometry is a reference only: it never forms extrudable regions. Default: `False`. |
  | `center` | array of number \| string | yes | [x, y] in the sketch plane, in the configured length unit (or strings with units, e.g. ['10 mm', '0.5 in']). |
  | `across_flats` | number \| string | yes | Number in the configured length unit, a string like '12.5 mm' / '0.5 in', or a Part Studio variable such as '#diameter' (the sketch then follows the variable). |

- **`line`** - Single line segment.

  | Field | Type | Required | Description |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `construction` | boolean | no | Construction geometry is a reference only: it never forms extrudable regions. Default: `False`. |
  | `start` | array of number \| string | yes | [x, y] in the sketch plane, in the configured length unit (or strings with units, e.g. ['10 mm', '0.5 in']). |
  | `end` | array of number \| string | yes | [x, y] in the sketch plane, in the configured length unit (or strings with units, e.g. ['10 mm', '0.5 in']). |

- **`polygon`** - Polyline through `points`; closed by default.

  | Field | Type | Required | Description |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `construction` | boolean | no | Construction geometry is a reference only: it never forms extrudable regions. Default: `False`. |
  | `points` | array of array of number \| string | yes |  |
  | `closed` | boolean | no | Default: `True`. |

- **`rectangle`** - Axis-aligned rectangle: `corner1` plus either the opposite corner `corner2`, or a `width` (along +X) and `height` (along +Y), which may be variables like '#width'.

  | Field | Type | Required | Description |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `construction` | boolean | no | Construction geometry is a reference only: it never forms extrudable regions. Default: `False`. |
  | `corner1` | array of number \| string | yes | [x, y] in the sketch plane, in the configured length unit (or strings with units, e.g. ['10 mm', '0.5 in']). |
  | `corner2` | array of number \| string | no |  |
  | `width` | number \| string | no | With `height`, instead of corner2. |
  | `height` | number \| string | no | With `width`, instead of corner2. |

### `extrude` ✏️

Extrude all closed regions of a sketch into a solid, or cut with it (operation 'remove'). The default direction follows the sketch plane's normal. For a sketch on a part's own face that normal points OUT of the part, so to cut a hole or pocket INTO the part pass opposite_direction=true (verified on live Onshape; without it nothing is cut). Always confirm with get_part_properties - the volume must drop. For operation 'new' the reply lists the created parts (parts_created) and names them when part_name is given.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `sketch_feature_id` | string | yes | feature_id returned by create_sketch. |
| `depth` | number \| string | yes | Length: a number in the configured unit (see get_settings; mm by default), a string with a unit such as '2.5 in', or an Onshape expression such as '#width'. |
| `operation` | 'new' \| 'add' \| 'remove' \| 'intersect' | no | 'new' creates a separate part; 'add' merges into existing parts; 'remove' cuts material away (holes, pockets); 'intersect' keeps only the overlap. Default: `new`. |
| `symmetric` | boolean | no | Extrude half the depth to each side of the sketch plane. Default: `False`. |
| `opposite_direction` | boolean | no | Flip to the other side of the sketch plane. Default: `False`. |
| `name` | string | no | Feature name. Defaults to its size: 'Extrude 8 mm' ('Cut 8 mm' for operation 'remove', 'Hole' with hole=true); with a variable depth the name shows the variable, e.g. 'Extrude #head_h'. |
| `hole` | boolean | no | The cut is a round drilled hole (use operation 'remove'): it is named 'Hole', without a size. Default: `False`. |
| `only_parts` | array of string | no | Part IDs (from list_parts) that operations 'add', 'remove' and 'intersect' should affect. By default Onshape applies them to every part the extrusion touches, which matters when several parts share one Part Studio (e.g. a bolt and a nut). |
| `part_name` | string | no | Name for the part an operation 'new' creates, e.g. 'M10x40 Hex Bolt'. Give one unless the user chose a name: otherwise the part stays 'Part N'. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |

| `edge_ids` | array of string | yes | Edge IDs from get_body_details to round. |
| `radius` | number \| string | yes | Length: a number in the configured unit (see get_settings; mm by default), a string with a unit such as '2.5 in', or an Onshape expression such as '#width'. |
| `name` | string | no | Default: `Fillet`. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |

| `edge_ids` | array of string | yes | Edge IDs from get_body_details to bevel. |
| `distance` | number \| string | yes | Length: a number in the configured unit (see get_settings; mm by default), a string with a unit such as '2.5 in', or an Onshape expression such as '#width'. |

### `update_feature` ✏️

Change parameters of existing features (for example make an extrude deeper or a fillet larger) without rebuilding them. Dependent features rebuild automatically. To change several features at once pass `updates`: two requests in total, however many. An automatically named extrude ('Extrude 8 mm') gets its name refreshed when its depth changes (single-feature form).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `feature_id` | string | no | Feature ID (list_features) when changing one feature. |
| `parameters` | object | no | Map of parameter ID to new value, e.g. {'depth': 25} for an extrude or {'radius': 2} for a fillet. Numbers are lengths in the configured unit (degrees for angle parameters). Strings may carry units ('1 in') or be expressions ('#width'). Booleans and enum names are set as-is. Use list_features with feature_id to see a feature's parameter IDs. |
| `name` | string | no | Optional new feature name. |
| `updates` | array of FeatureUpdate | no | Change SEVERAL features in ONE Onshape request instead of feature_id + parameters. Names are not changed in this form. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |

### `delete_feature` ✏️ ⚠️

Permanently remove a feature from the Part Studio. Features that depend on it (for example an extrude that uses a deleted sketch) will fail. Onshape's version history can restore it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `feature_id` | string | yes | Feature ID as returned by list_features or a create tool. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |

### `add_feature` ✏️

Advanced escape hatch: add any Onshape feature from raw JSON - revolve, patterns, sweeps, holes, and so on. Copy the structure from an existing feature (`list_features` with `feature_id`) or from `onshape_api_request` on the Part Studio `featurespecs` endpoint. Raw JSON uses Onshape's native units (lengths are written as expressions like '10 mm').

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `feature` | object | yes | Onshape feature JSON (a BTMFeature-134 object with featureType, name and parameters). A full BTFeatureDefinitionCall body is accepted too. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |

### `add_custom_feature` ✏️

Add a custom feature (a Feature Studio script such as Thread Creator) to a Part Studio. Find its feature_type and parameter IDs with list_custom_features first. Returns the new feature_id and its health status; if that is ERROR or WARNING, inspect it with list_features(feature_id=...), then fix it with update_feature or remove it with delete_feature.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `feature_type` | string | yes | feature_type of the custom feature, from list_custom_features. |
| `parameters` | object | no | Map of parameter ID to value, using the IDs from list_custom_features. Lengths are numbers in the configured unit (strings may carry units or be expressions such as '#width'); angles are degrees; enums take one of the listed options; booleans are true/false; selections (type 'query') are lists of face / edge / part IDs from get_body_details or list_parts. Anything left out keeps the script's own default. |
| `name` | string | no | Name; defaults to the script's. |
| `namespace` | string | no | Only to choose between custom features that share a feature_type; copy it exactly from list_custom_features. |
| `feature_studio_url` | string | no | Browser URL of the Feature Studio tab that defines the feature, for a Feature Script that list_custom_features does not show for this Part Studio. From another document it must be a version URL (/documents/<did>/v/<vid>/e/<eid>). |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |

## Names, variables, configurations and assemblies

Defaults for tidy parametric models, plus the optional features that are used only when asked for. See [Parametric modeling](parametric.md).

### `rename` ✏️

Give a part, or a whole tab (Part Studio / Assembly), a descriptive name. Do this by default: a part still called 'Part 2' or a tab still called 'Part Studio 1' says nothing. Keep a name the user chose; rename only placeholders (flagged has_default_name by get_document and list_parts) unless the user asks otherwise.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `name` | string | yes | The new name, e.g. 'M10x40 Hex Bolt' for a part or 'M10 Fasteners' for a tab. |
| `part_id` | string | no | Part ID from list_parts to rename that part. Leave out to rename the whole tab (the Part Studio / Assembly itself). |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |

### `set_variable` ✏️

Create a Part Studio variable, or change its value if it already exists. By default model with variables: put every key dimension (diameter, length, pitch, wall thickness, ...) in a variable first, then use '#name' wherever the size is needed, so changing one value reshapes the whole model. Pass `variables` to set many in one call.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `name` | string | no | Variable name: letters, digits and underscores, e.g. 'shank_diameter'. Referenced as '#shank_diameter'. Omit when using `variables`. |
| `value` | number \| integer \| string | no | A number (length in the configured unit, degrees for an angle), a string with a unit ('1.5 mm'), or an expression using other variables ('#shank_diameter / 2'). Omit when using by_option. |
| `kind` | 'length' \| 'angle' \| 'number' | no | Quantity type; only used when the variable is created. Default: `length`. |
| `by_option` | object | no | Make the value depend on a configuration LIST input: {'Size': {'M10': 10, 'M18': 18}} gives 10 for M10 and 18 for M18. Every option of the input needs a value. Create the input first with set_configuration_input. Only when the user asks for configurations. |
| `variables` | object | no | Set SEVERAL variables at once, e.g. {'d': 10, 'pitch': 1.5, 'head_h': 6.4}: existing ones change in ONE Onshape request, new ones are created. Instead of name / value. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |

### `set_configuration_input` ✏️

Add a configuration input to a Part Studio, or replace the input of the same name. Only when the user asks for configurations. To make dimensions depend on a list input, use set_variable with `by_option`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `name` | string | yes | Input name, e.g. 'Size' or 'Length'. Number inputs are usable in expressions as '#Length'. |
| `kind` | 'list' \| 'length' \| 'angle' \| 'number' | no | Type of input. Default: `list`. |
| `options` | array of string | no | For a list: the choices, e.g. ['M10', 'M18'] (at least two). |
| `default` | string \| number \| integer | no | List: the default option (first one if omitted). Number inputs: the default value (length in the configured unit, degrees for an angle). |
| `minimum` | number | no | Number inputs: lowest value. |
| `maximum` | number | no | Number inputs: highest value. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |

### `insert_instance` ✏️

Insert a part (or a whole Part Studio) into an Assembly and return the new instances' IDs and names. Name the Assembly tab (rename) if it still says 'Assembly N'. Only when the user asks for an assembly. Join parts with add_mate.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `assembly_id` | string | yes | Element ID of the Assembly tab (get_document). |
| `source_element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `part_id` | string | no | Part ID (list_parts) of the one part to insert. Leave out to insert the whole Part Studio as one instance. |
| `source_document_id` | string | no | Document that holds the Part Studio; defaults to this document. |
| `configuration` | object | no | Variant of a configured Part Studio to insert, e.g. {'Size': 'M18'}. |
| `fixed` | boolean | no | Ground the instance (it cannot move). Usually the first one. Default: `False`. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |

### `add_mate` ✏️

Join two part instances of an Assembly with a mate. Pick a spot on each: for a nut on a bolt use the bolt's circular end edge (at 'center') and a face of the nut (at 'centroid'), with mate_type 'cylindrical' (free to turn and slide) or 'fastened'. The first instance stays where it is if it is grounded; the second moves to satisfy the mate. Returns the real status and both instances' resulting positions. Only when the user asks for an assembly. Note: the centroid of a threaded face can sit ~0.2 mm off the thread's axis.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `assembly_id` | string | yes | Element ID of the Assembly tab (get_document). |
| `mate_type` | 'fastened' \| 'revolute' \| 'slider' \| 'planar' \| 'cylindrical' \| 'pin_slot' \| 'ball' \| 'parallel' | yes | fastened: no motion; revolute: rotates about the axis; cylindrical: rotates and slides along it (a nut on a bolt); slider, planar, pin_slot, ball, parallel as in Onshape. |
| `first` | MateSide | yes |  |
| `second` | MateSide | yes |  |
| `name` | string | no | Defaults to e.g. 'Cylindrical 1'. |
| `flip` | boolean | no | Flip the primary axis (the second part faces the other way). Default: `False`. |
| `offset` | array of number \| string | no | [x, y, z] offset between the connectors, in the configured length unit (strings may carry units). |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |

## Look & export

Screenshots (with the token-saving review toggle) and file export.

### `capture_screenshot` 🔍

Render a shaded screenshot of a Part Studio or Assembly from one or more standard camera angles. Images are always saved to disk. Whether they are also returned to you for visual inspection depends on the `review` flag / server setting - with review off you get only paths and metadata, which keeps token use low. Use it to visually verify what you built (shape, hole placement, orientation).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |
| `views` | array of 'isometric' \| 'front' \| 'back' \| 'left' \| 'right' \| 'top' \| 'bottom' | no | Camera angles to render. Every extra view is an extra image (and, if review is on, extra tokens). Default: `['isometric']`. |
| `part_id` | string | no | Render only this part (Part Studios only). |
| `configuration` | object | no |  |
| `width` | integer | no | Image width in pixels (default from server settings). |
| `height` | integer | no | Image height in pixels (default from server settings). |
| `show_edges` | boolean | no | Draw visible edges. Default: `True`. |
| `review` | boolean | no | true: send the image(s) to you so you can look at them (costs tokens, ~width*height/750 per image). false: only save them to disk and return the file paths (no image tokens). Omit to use the server's ONSHAPE_SCREENSHOT_REVIEW setting. |

### `export_model` 🔍

Export a Part Studio or Assembly to a CAD/mesh file (STEP, STL, Parasolid, IGES) on the machine running this server and return the file path. Does not modify the document. STL sizes follow the configured unit system.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | string | yes | Onshape document ID: the 24-character hex string after /documents/ in the document URL. Get it from list_documents. |
| `element_id` | string | yes | Element (tab) ID: the string after /e/ in the Onshape URL. Get it from get_document. |
| `workspace_id` | string | no | Workspace ID (the string after /w/ in the URL). Optional - defaults to the document's main workspace. |
| `format` | 'STEP' \| 'STL' \| 'PARASOLID' \| 'IGES' | no | Output file format. Default: `STEP`. |
| `part_ids` | array of string | no | Export only these parts (Part Studios only). Default: everything. |
| `filename` | string | no | File name without directory (default: the element ID). Saved under the server's output directory. |

## Escape hatch

Anything the dedicated tools do not cover.

### `onshape_api_request` ✏️ ⚠️

Escape hatch: call any Onshape REST endpoint directly. Use it for things the dedicated tools do not cover. WARNING: this is the raw API - lengths are in METERS (no unit conversion), POST/DELETE can change or destroy data, and in read-only mode only GET is allowed. Large responses are truncated.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | 'GET' \| 'POST' \| 'DELETE' | yes | HTTP method. |
| `path` | string | yes | API path relative to /api/vNN, e.g. '/documents' or '/partstudios/d/<did>/w/<wid>/e/<eid>/featurespecs'. See the Onshape API Explorer: https://cad.onshape.com/glassworks/explorer |
| `query` | object | no | Query-string parameters. |
| `body` | object | no | JSON request body for POST. |
